text:
Priya: quick thread  post-launch decision: do we include embedding-client telemetry and the small UI latency fix in Friday's hotpatch or leave both for the 2-week mini-wave?
Omar: embedding telemetry is noisy but gives critical signal for rerank regressions. how big is the UI fix?
Lin: UI fix = debounce tweak on suggestions panel, ~2 dev days + 1 QE day. embedding telemetry = adding counts & histograms to the client payload (no schema change) + backend parsers, ~3 dev days.
Bea: QE capacity limited Fri. hotpatch QE window is 24hrs. embedding telemetry needs extra end-to-end checks, might not fit.
Priya: constraint: we must ship a fix for a rare latency spike affecting 0.4% of sessions this week or customer SLO hits will be red. the spike is unrelated to embeddings.
Omar: suggestion: ship UI debounce in hotpatch (it's small and reduces spike), but gate embedding telemetry behind a flag and target it to internal-only in hotpatch. run full telemetry rollout in mini-wave after we validate.
Lin: agree. counterpoint: flagged telemetry still touches parsers; need a kill-switch in case of pipeline errors. add a feature toggle + quick path to drop client side samples.
Bea: we should define rollback triggers. propose: rollback if p50 latency regresses > 25ms or error-rate increase > 0.2% over baseline in the canary. Also abort telemetry ingest if malformed payload rate > 0.05%.
Priya: owners: Lin -> UI debounce PR, Omar -> telemetry sampler behind flag + ingest safelist, Bea -> QE plan + smoke tests, Priya -> release notes and customer comms.
release-bot: scheduled canary: v2026.03.12-patch1 -> Thu 09:30 UTC to "canary-internal". Checks: smoke, latency, error-rate, ingest-health.
Omar: timeline: I can land a feature-flagged telemetry branch by Wed EOD and add the ingest safelist. need a 1hr review from Lin.
Lin: I can review Wed 10:00 UTC. QA pairing request: Bea, can you pair Wed 11:00 for e2e?
Bea: yes Wed 11:00 works. QE will run: 6 smoke cases + 4 regression scenarios focused on suggestions panel and embedding ingest path.
Priya: communications: customer note will mention hotpatch fixes and that embedding telemetry will be optional/internal in hotpatch, full rollout next mini-wave. target CS review by Wed 15:00 UTC.
Omar: ops: add a short-circuit endpoint to drop client telemetry if pipeline shows errors. I'll add to runbook and health dashboard.
Bea: accepted. I'll encode rollback steps in the ops doc: revert debounce commit, toggle off telemetry flag, flip ingest short-circuit.
Priya: decision summary: include UI debounce in hotpatch; embed telemetry deferred to hotpatch behind internal-only flag with kill-switch; full telemetry rollout in mini-wave. Owners and timelines assigned.
Lin: :thumbsup:
Omar: :eyes: will prep flag and short-circuit.
Bea: QE will be ready for canary smoke.
release-bot: reminder scheduled: pre-canary sync Thu 08:45 UTC.
Priya: if anything shows up overnight ping me directly. we'll do pre-canary huddle Thu 08:45.
Omar: ack.
Lin: ack.
Bea: ack.
